name: Susan G. Komen Customized Cash Rewards Visa Credit Card

localized_names.en: Susan G. Komen Customized Cash Rewards Visa Credit Card

apr.notes: 0% intro APR for the first 15 billing cycles on purchases and on balance transfers made within the first 60 days, then a variable APR currently 17.74% to 27.74%. 3% intro balance transfer fee for the first 60 days, then 5%.

base_rate.description: Unlimited 1% cash back on all other purchases.

categories.label: Choice category (gas and EV charging, online shopping, dining, travel, drug stores, or home improvement and furnishings)

rewards.redemption_notes: Redeem cash back as a statement credit, a deposit into a Bank of America checking or savings account, or a credit to an eligible Merrill account.

signup_bonus.description: $200 online cash rewards bonus after at least $1,000 in purchases in the first 90 days of account opening.

notes: The 3% choice category and 2% grocery and wholesale club rates apply to the first $2,500 in combined purchases each quarter, then 1%. In the first year a 3% first-year bonus raises the choice category to 6%. Bank of America makes a contribution to Susan G. Komen for each new account that is used within, and remains open for, the first 90 days.
